mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_device ( id, product_source, product_code, product_id, code, serial_number, display_name, remark, thing_model_version, binding_generation, protocol_code, connection_protocol, connection_identifier_type, connection_identifier_value) VALUES ( #{id}, #{productSource}, #{productCode}, #{productId}, #{code}, #{serialNumber}, #{displayName}, #{remark}, #{thingModelVersion}, 1, #{protocolCode}, #{connectionProtocol}, #{connectionIdentifierType}, #{connectionIdentifierValue})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, product_source, product_code, product_id, code, serial_number, display_name, remark, thing_model_version, binding_generation, protocol_code, connection_protocol, connection_identifier_type, connection_identifier_value FROM iot_device
ORDER BY
created_at ASC,
created_at updated_at code id id
DESC ASC
,
id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

where.if: AND (POSITION(LOWER(#{search}) IN LOWER(code)) > 0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{search}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(serial_number, ''))) > 0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{search}) IN LOWER(display_name)) > 0)

mapper.update:
UPDATE iot_device
display_name = #{update.displayName.value},
display_name = NULL,
remark = #{update.remark.value},
remark = NULL,
WHERE id = #{deviceId}

UPDATE iot_device SET thing_model_version = #{thingModelVersion}, protocol_code = #{protocolCode}, binding_generation = #{bindingGeneration}, desired_sequence = 0 WHERE id = #{deviceId} AND binding_generation = #{expectedBindingGeneration}
